findings.note: The spec hardcodes the author name 'autotest_user_admin'. It will fail if the suite is run under another account, such as TEST_USER_B. The AFS observed this name on one account only. Consider asserting only a non-empty author, or derive the name from config or the profile. Non-blocking.

The relevance check `'run' in reply.lower()` is weak. The instruction is 'uppercase the input', so the reply 'RUN' would match, but any reply that mentions 'run' also passes. Acceptable given LLM nondeterminism, and the AFS declares it. A stricter `reply.strip().upper() == 'RUN'` is optional.

The case's steps 13-14 'success indicator' and the 'panel on the right side' are asserted only as absence of alerts and error text, and panel visibility (no position check). Both are declared clarifications in the AFS, so this is not a defect.
